notes.title: Patch 1.1.
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,
we are pleased to announce that we have released patch 1.1. In this patch we have worked on battle rebalance and expanded the story. We are still working on implementing achievements. Please stay tuned for further updates.

Development plan:
We are working on update 1.2. and update 1.3. that will focus on expanding the out of combat content and story. Offcourse minor bugs will still be removed in minor updates. Patch 1.2 will be out next week and patch 1.3. should be complete in 2-3 weeks.

Happy Adventuring

notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers,

we are grateful for all the feedback we have received so far. Some issues regarding game balance, spelling mistakes and minor bugs will be addressed and fixed immediately in an upcoming patch in the next couple of days.

In the much bigger upcoming 1.1 patch we would like to add more story and out of combat related content, in order to make the game more diverse. If we find any more issues we will do our best to fix them in order to provide the best possible experience while playing our game.


-Edit:
Patch 1.0.1 that adressed spelling mistakes and a minor balance update (adjusted character agility, buffs and nerfs to certain enemie, reduced number of random encounters) was just released.

Thank you for all the support,

Team Amaterasu
